method: All 24 GitHub assets were downloaded locally and verified by size/SHA-256, then rsync uploaded. The server prepare-publication gate exited 0 after full size/SHA-256/SHA-512 verification of all 22 indexed lane files and validation of six architectures/feeds/formats/signing metadata. Only then was release-current atomically switched. Public API installer sizes/SHA-256/SHA-512 were separately compared with the frozen build audit; public HEAD/Range/feeds are recorded in live-release.json. No historical installer bytes were modified.
